articles.title: Drugmakers and PhRMA Intervene in Hospital 340B Rebate Litigation
articles.summary: Pharmaceutical manufacturers and industry group PhRMA are moving to intervene in a legal challenge brought by hospitals over 340B drug pricing and manufacturer rebate restrictions. This ongoing dispute directly impacts the 340B program ecosystem, which influences drug distribution economics and cost dynamics for self-funded health plans.
articles.source_line: Source: Fierce Healthcare; Thu, 15 Oct 2026 20:44:36 GMT

articles.title: UnitedHealth Projects Commercial Health Plan Costs to Surge Over 11%
articles.summary: UnitedHealth Group has projected that commercial health plan cost increases will exceed 11%, signaling intensifying financial pressure for commercial buyers. This sharp rise in health care trend is highly relevant to self-funded employers seeking strategies to mitigate escalating medical and pharmacy benefit expenditures. The trend underscores the urgent need for robust cost containment and transparent PBM management.

articles.title: Prime Therapeutics Reworks Rebate Model and Defends Express Scripts Alliance
articles.summary: Prime Therapeutics is restructuring its rebate and pricing strategies while defending its strategic partnership with Express Scripts. For self-funded employers, shifts in PBM rebate aggregation and major alliance alignments directly impact drug cost transparency, net spend calculations, and contract negotiations.
articles.source_line: Source: Modern Healthcare; Thu, 15 Oct 2026 10:00:00 GMT

articles.title: Pennsylvania Attorney General Sues Insulin Makers and PBMs Over Pricing Scheme
articles.summary: The Pennsylvania Attorney General has filed a lawsuit accusing major insulin manufacturers and pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) of orchestrating an artificial pricing scheme. This legal action highlights ongoing state-level scrutiny of PBM business practices and drug pricing, signaling potential compliance and litigation risks for self-funded employer health plans navigating manufacturer and PBM contracts.
articles.source_line: Source: Pennsylvania Capital-Star; Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:33:13 GMT

articles.title: Epic Launches Multi-Vendor Drug Pricing Tool Disrupting Pharmacy Benefit Market
articles.summary: Electronic health record giant Epic is collaborating with Amazon Pharmacy, Eli Lilly, and Mark Cuban Cost Plus Drug Company to integrate real-time drug pricing directly into clinical workflows. This tool empowers prescribers and patients to compare cash-pay, discount, and traditional benefit prices at the point of care, threatening traditional PBM channel control and forcing self-funded plan sponsors to rethink benefit navigation.
articles.source_line: Source: Fierce Healthcare; Thu, 15 Oct 2026 21:30:00 GMT

articles.title: Pennsylvania Files Lawsuit Against Drugmakers and PBMs Over Insulin Pricing
articles.summary: Pennsylvania has launched legal action against major pharmaceutical manufacturers and pharmacy benefit managers, targeting insulin pricing strategies and alleged inflation of drug costs. This litigation highlights the growing state-level scrutiny facing PBM pricing models, which directly impacts self-funded employers seeking cost transparency and liability protection. The case signals continued regulatory and legal pressure on PBM business practices.
